concerns.text: Task T014 generates a 'frequency-weighted' proxy utility from static logs rather than using the actual static retrieval logs from the original AgenticSTS runs as the proxy. This violates FR-006 which mandates validating the proxy assumption by testing correlation between 'static-log-derived utility' (from original runs) and 'ablation-derived utility'. The task creates a circular validation by deriving a new proxy instead of using the ground-truth static logs, weakening the requirement to test the specific assumption defined in the spec.

Task T008 calculates `utility_delta` as `baseline_win_rate - ablated_win_rate` but does not explicitly mandate running the full 'all-layers' baseline for every trajectory in the training set first to establish the `baseline_win_rate`. FR-001 defines ground-truth utility as the measured impact when a layer is removed, which requires a consistent reference point (the full baseline). Without this explicit step, the utility labels may lack the required reference, weakening the FR-001 deliverable.

Task T026 exits with code 1 (FAIL) if ANY success criterion (SC-001 to SC-004) is false. SC-002 requires verifying a token reduction of 'at least 30%'. If the reduction is <30%, the pipeline halts before generating the statistical evidence (SC-001, SC-003, SC-004) required to interpret the result. This violates the research goal of producing a report regardless of the outcome, effectively weakening the requirement to measure and report the results even if the hypothesis is not supported.

Task T021 aggregates average win rate and token usage but does not include a step to calculate and output the 'standard deviation of token savings' required by SC-004. SC-004 explicitly requires measuring 'Token reduction consistency' via standard deviation. The absence of this calculation in the task list means the acceptance criterion cannot be verified, constituting a dropped acceptance criterion.

Task T059 verifies NaN/Inf handling in the entropy module (T006b) but omits the explicit requirement to verify that the *dynamic selection logic* (T015b) correctly consumes the sentinel value to trigger the 'all-layers' fallback. The spec's Edge Cases section mandates that the system MUST default to retrieving the full set and log a warning. Verifying only the entropy module leaves the critical consumption logic unverified, weakening the edge-case handling requirement.
